title: CPSC, CFM Corporation Announce Recall to Repair Vermont Castings Five-Burner Barbeque Grills
summary: Gas leak and fire hazard. The burner tubes may not fit fully into the gas valves. If a consumer pulls on the console, the metal may flex and the gas valves may disconnect from the burners, releasing gas and creating a fire risk that could cause injury and property damage. Units: About 12,500.

title: CPSC, Stack-On Products Co., Inc. Announce Recall of Stack-On Strong Box Safes
summary: These safes can be opened without the use of a combination by jiggling with the door knob. This could allow unauthorized access to a handgun and the potential for serious injury. Units: 1,320.

title: CPSC, Aloha Housewares Inc. Announce Voluntary Recall of Radiant Heaters
summary: Recessed thermal protector may cause a fire hazard if heater is left on, while covered by a blanket or similar item. Units: About 30,000.

title: CPSC, Bilt-Safe Technologies Announce Recall of Electric Blankets
summary: When the temperature controller on the blanket is reset multiple times or the blanket is folded or covered with additional blankets, the blanket can overheat. This can result in smoldering and melting, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: 60,000, including 13,720 sold to consumers.

title: CPSC, Black Diamond Equipment Announce Recall of Headlamp Batteries
summary: The headlamp battery may overheat, posing a burn or fire hazard to users. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC, Deere & Company Announce Recall of Gator HPX Utility Vehicles
summary: Loss of brake system pressure can decrease the effectiveness of the brakes. Units: 14,746.

title: CPSC, General Binding Corp. Announce Recall of Pouch Laminators
summary: Improper wiring at the heating coil could cause the pouch laminators to overheat and become a fire hazard. Units: About 34,600.

title: CPSC, Answer Products Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Suspension Forks
summary: The top of the Manitou bicycle suspension fork, when fully compressed, may contact the front tire, resulting in a loss of control of the bicycle and presenting a fall hazard to a bicyclist. Units: About 8,032.

title: CPSC, Cannondale Bicycle Corp. Announce Recall of Certain Quick-Release Handlebar Bags
summary: The plastic, handlebar-mounted, quick-release bags can fall off the bicycle while it is being ridden, causing the rider to crash. Units: About 2,600.

title: CPSC, Cordelia Lighting Announce Recall of Hampton Bay® Light Fixtures Sold at Expo Design Centers
summary: The decorative metal rings on the ends of the lamp fixtures can detach. Consumers could suffer minor burns if they touch the hot rings. Units: About 1,400.

title: CPSC, Petit Bateau Announce Recall of Children's Bathrobes
summary: These robes fail to meet the children's sleepwear flammability standards, posing a risk of burn injury to children, due to the possible ignition of the garment. Units: About 2,700.

title: CPSC, Valvoline Announce Recall of Brake Cleaner and Brake Parts Cleaner
summary: The affected aerosol cans contain a defective spray valve that might stick when depressed, possibly emptying the can's flammable contents. Units: 2.8 million cans.

title: CPSC, adidas America Inc. Announce Recall of Basketball Shoes
summary: A portion of the sole of the heel can separate or tear during use, which can result in injuries. Units: About 187,000 pairs.

title: CPSC, Schneider Electric North American Division Announce Recall of AFCIs
summary: An AFCI is an electrical circuit protection device (circuit breaker) that detects electrical arcs from cracked, broken or damaged electrical insulation and shuts off power to the circuit before the arcing leads to a fire. An electronic component failure inside the AFCIs can cause the devices to not

title: CPSC, Quality Bicycle Products Announce Recall of Bicycle Forks
summary: The steering tube on the bicycle fork can crack or break, causing a sudden loss of steering control and causing a fall hazard to bicyclists. Units: About 500.

title: CPSC, Robertshaw Controls Company Announce Recall of TS-11 Thermal Safety Control Gas Valves
summary: If the pilot light goes out, the gas valve can stick in an open position, permitting gas to continue to flow. This can result in a gas explosion and fire, which could result in severe personal injury or property damage. Units: 123,544 gas valves and 37,350 magnet heads.

title: CPSC, Meijer Distribution Announce Recall of Children's Snow Suits, Jackets
summary: These snow suits and jackets have decorative compasses and corded zipper pull tags that can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 175,000.

title: CPSC, Procter & Gamble Announce Recall of Sweep+Vac Battery-Operated Vacuum Cleaner by Swiffer
summary: In some cases, when the vacuum cleaner is left in the "on" position, the rotor can lock up and cause the unit to overheat. This poses a smoke and fire hazard. Units: About 175,000.

title: CPSC, Deere & Company Announce Recall of Riding Mowers
summary: The fuel tanks can crack and leak fuel, presenting a potential for fire or burn injuries. Units: 4,400.

title: CPSC, Hanna Andersson Announce Recall of Children's Corduroy Overalls
summary: The buttons on the front and side panels of the overalls can detach from the garment, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,900.

title: CPSC, Fitness Quest Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Ab Lounge™ Exercise Products
summary: When opening or folding up these exercise machines, consumers can catch their fingers in the hinges. This can result in lacerations, crushing, or amputation to fingertips. This does not occur while users are exercising. Units: About 460,000.

title: CPSC, Lakewood Announce Recall of Fan-Forced Mini-Personal Heaters
summary: Fire hazard if an electrical failure leads to overheating and melting of plastic parts. Units: About 18,000.

title: CPSC, Byer of Maine Announce Recall to Exchange TriLite Stools
summary: The legs of the stool can bend and the stools may collapse, when used on smooth hard floor surfaces. Units: About 7,800.

title: CPSC, Emerson Motor Co. Announce Recall of 3.7-Inch Stators
summary: Under locked condition, it can become overheated and present a potential fire/shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,877.

title: CPSC, Kubota Announce Recall of Utility Vehicles
summary: The front hood of the RTV900 utility vehicle can come off during operation, striking the driver or passenger and causing serious personal injury. Units: About 16,000.

title: CPSC, Midwest and GE Announce Recall of Meter Load Centers
summary: Some of these products were sold with loose internal bolt connections, which could result in excessive heat or fire. Units: 2,754, manufactured from May through August 6, 2004.

title: CPSC, Chicago Imports Announce Recall of Electric Pictures
summary: These pictures have inadequate construction, incorrect wiring, and use flammable materials, all of which pose fire and electric shock hazards to consumers. Units: 55,600.

title: CPSC, J.C. Penney Corporation Announce Recall of Children's Pajama Sets
summary: The heat-sealed patches on the front of the garment can detach, posing a possible choking hazard to young children. Units: About 41,300.

title: CPSC, Country Home Products, Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Cordless Electric Lawnmowers
summary: These lawnmowers contain an electronic switch in their handlebar. In certain instances, this switch is not aligned properly, in which case the mower does not comply with the mandatory federal safety standard for lawnmowers under the Federal Hazardous Substances Act. title: CPSC, Maytag Corp. Announce Recall of Jenn-Air Gas Cooktops
summary: The recalled cooktops have switches located too close to the gas tubing leading to the grill burner. Electrical arcing can cause the tubing to leak gas and ignite, resulting in a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,170.

title: CPSC, Ocean Management Systems Announce Recall of SCUBA Manifolds
summary: Undersized o-rings installed on the cross bar can cause a loss of breathing air from the SCUBA cylinder, presenting a risk of drowning. Units: About 140.

title: CPSC, The Nautilus Group Announce Recall to Repair Bowflex Power Pro and Ultimate Fitness Machines
summary: The seat pin on the Power Pro with "Lat Tower" and Ultimate models can break or become disengaged, allowing the seat to move suddenly. Also, the incline support bracket on the Power Pro without a "Lat Tower" can break, allowing the incline bench to move suddenly. Both hazards pose a fall risk to the

title: CPSC, RMM Corporation Announce Recall of BLACK CAT® Electric Pressure Washers
summary: The electric motor in the pressure washer can overheat and melt the housing, possibly igniting nearby flammable materials or exposing live electrical parts. Units: About 30,500.

title: CPSC, Robert Bosch Tool Corp. Announce Recall of Abrasive Cut-Off Wheels
summary: These abrasive cut-off wheels do not have correct speed rating labels. If used at the labeled speed rating, the wheels can burst, causing possible injury to user and bystanders. Units: About 6,400.

title: CPSC, York International Announce Recall of Gas Furnaces
summary: These furnaces can overheat, causing heat-exchanger cracking, burn-through and, in extreme cases, furnace wrapper burn-through. This can lead to heating and possible burning of the drywall and other combustibles adjacent to the furnace, which poses a fire and smoke hazard to consumers. Units: About

title: CPSC, Classic Sport Companies Inc. Announce Recall of Table Soccer Games
summary: The lighting structures may spark if the tube lights are not properly installed, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,470.
